metadata.description: Loyalty points/miles activity extraction skills for Claude — turns your own logged-in browser session into a unified CSV per program.

plugins.name: points-activity
plugins.description: Extract loyalty points/miles account activity from airline and hotel programs (Hyatt, United, IHG, Accor, Aeroplan + generic playbook) into a unified CSV plus current balance. Uses your own logged-in browser session via the Claude in Chrome MCP — no credentials stored, no data leaves your machine.
